g.text: Restaurant Rush - sequence diagram (1/10): the Critic's visit in the Stage 3 victory run - turn 7 begins
C3 is a Critic: arrival #3 on turn 7, loses 12 satisfaction per waiting turn,
and reacts to how fresh the food is when it is served.
Manager choices that change the outcome
(1) Turn 8 (page 5): switch on Happy Hour, so C3 recovers 15 at the start of turns 8 and 9.
If Happy Hour is never used, C3 pays with satisfaction 76 instead of 100.
(2) Turn 9 (page 7): serve C3 on the only turn the dish is still fresh. If the Waiter waits
instead, C3 loses 12 more and the dish is cold on turn 10 (-20): C3 pays with 68.
The result check (page 10) shows what each choice does to the final score.
Start of turn: Happy Hour decision
